svg.title: The morning run
svg.desc: Every day at 06:00 India time the scheduler calls the daily route with a secret bearer token. Dueline checks the token in constant time and claims the India day in the store. It rebuilds the invoice snapshot from PayPal, drafts reminders for overdue and due-soon invoices within the daily model allowance, replaces the reminder items in the queue, turns due monthly repeats into drafts, reconciles payments from the last 14 days, rebuilds the snapshot again and returns a digest. The run never creates, sends or reminds anything. A second call on the same day finds the day already claimed and returns the stored result without calling PayPal or the model.
svg.text: Once per India day, however many times it is asked for. It only prepares.

g.text: At 06:00 India time the scheduler calls the daily route
The route checks the secret bearer token
It claims today's India date in the store
It reloads the invoices from PayPal
It drafts reminders, within the daily allowance
It fills the queue, moves repeats on and reconciles payments
It rebuilds the snapshot and returns the digest. Nothing is sent
A second call that day gets the stored result. PayPal is not called
